result:
I could not verify the claimed counts (57, 63), and they look too high, so I reject the answer.

- The proposed solution gives no derivation. It only asserts that the counts are "known".
- Abstract isomorphism merges many affinely distinct rod groups. For example, the 7 frieze groups collapse to 4 abstract classes: Z, Z×C₂, D∞ and D∞×C₂. The rod groups should therefore collapse well below 57 classes out of 75.
- The layer-group count of 63 out of 80 also seems too high, though I could not compute the exact figure.
- From memory, the published classification gives much smaller numbers for both families, but I cannot recall the exact values.

VERDICT: REJECT
